instruction: Find the potted plant, approach until the body touches it, and stop.

videoNote: Chronological head-camera observations from this evaluation, displayed at two observations per second. This is not continuous action footage; playback time does not represent episode elapsed time. No interpolation or rerendering.

steps.code:
import primitive_api as p

# First cell: observe and yield to see the current scene
p.observe()
print("Observation taken. Awaiting image to locate the potted plant.")
